description: Land Acquisition - Vawlawa, Polpithigama D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed declarations for the acquisition of specific land parcels, including their lot numbers, extents, boundaries, and locations. While a government minister is named, the core content focuses entirely on land/property matters rather than government personnel or structural changes, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
